series.name: FMSCT Thailand Superbike / Thailand Road Racing Championship
series.notes: FMSCT national asphalt championship. 2026 rounds listed at Thailand Circuit Motorsport Complex (Nakhon Pathom), not Chang. Distinct from NEXZTER BRIC Superbike.

series.name: NEXZTER BRIC Superbike Championship
series.notes: Chang / Buriram national superbike brand for 2026 (Siam Sport / Motowish). Separate from FMSCT Thailand Superbike at Thailand Circuit.

series.name: Asia Road Racing Championship (ARRC)
series.notes: Regional FIM Asia series with Thailand rounds at Chang / Bangsaen.
